Name: Unbreakable Tackles
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=5][b]About : 
[/b][/size]I was in a discord call playing the game with some friends and one of them was complaining that his tackle broke right before night market. (his own fault tbh)
So instead of trying to argue, I made this in 10 minutes.
There is also an option in the config for your rod not to consume bait (because why not)

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b]
[/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip file and place in the mod folder

[size=4][b]Also : [/b]
[/size]This mod uses harmony, harmony is prone to giving errors without many details, if something is to happen please send over a log file and it will be dealt with swiftly.

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/Unbreakable%20Tackles][Source Code]
